SELECT 'SALES' record_type,l.id,l.organization_id,l.farm_id,NULL zone_id,NULL crop_id,NULL variety_id,NULL season_id, NULL work_type_id,l.customer_id,l.sales_date record_date,NULL worker_count,NULL work_hours, NULL chemical_name,NULL target_pest,NULL dilution_ratio,NULL amount_value,NULL amount_unit,NULL preharvest_interval_days, NULL grade,l.quantity,l.unit,NULL package_unit,l.item_name,l.unit_price,l.gross_amount,l.fee_amount,l.net_amount, l.net_amount_overridden_yn,l.settlement_status,l.memo,l.created_role,l.care_assignment_id,l.farmer_confirm_status, l.farmer_confirmed_by,l.farmer_confirmed_at,l.version,l.client_request_id,l.created_by,u.display_name created_by_name, l.created_at,l.updated_by,l.updated_at,l.deleted_at FROM sales_log l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=l.created_by

mapper.update: UPDATE work_log SET zone_id=#{row.zoneId},crop_id=#{row.cropId},variety_id=#{row.varietyId},season_id=#{row.seasonId}, work_date=#{row.recordDate},work_type_id=#{row.workTypeId},worker_count=#{row.workerCount},work_hours=#{row.workHours},memo=#{row.memo}, farmer_confirm_status=#{row.farmerConfirmStatus},farmer_confirmed_by=#{row.farmerConfirmedBy},farmer_confirmed_at=#{row.farmerConfirmedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},version=version+1 WHERE farm_id=#{row.farmId} AND id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE pest_control_log SET zone_id=#{row.zoneId},crop_id=#{row.cropId},variety_id=#{row.varietyId},season_id=#{row.seasonId}, apply_date=#{row.recordDate},chemical_name=#{row.chemicalName},target_pest=#{row.targetPest},dilution_ratio=#{row.dilutionRatio}, amount_value=#{row.amountValue},amount_unit=#{row.amountUnit},preharvest_interval_days=#{row.preharvestIntervalDays},memo=#{row.memo}, farmer_confirm_status=#{row.farmerConfirmStatus},farmer_confirmed_by=#{row.farmerConfirmedBy},farmer_confirmed_at=#{row.farmerConfirmedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},version=version+1 WHERE farm_id=#{row.farmId} AND id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE harvest_log SET zone_id=#{row.zoneId},crop_id=#{row.cropId},variety_id=#{row.varietyId},season_id=#{row.seasonId}, harvest_date=#{row.recordDate},grade=#{row.grade},quantity=#{row.quantity},unit=#{row.unit},package_unit=#{row.packageUnit},memo=#{row.memo}, farmer_confirm_status=#{row.farmerConfirmStatus},farmer_confirmed_by=#{row.farmerConfirmedBy},farmer_confirmed_at=#{row.farmerConfirmedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},version=version+1 WHERE farm_id=#{row.farmId} AND id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE sales_log SET customer_id=#{row.customerId},sales_date=#{row.recordDate},item_name=#{row.itemName}, quantity=#{row.quantity},unit=#{row.unit},unit_price=#{row.unitPrice},gross_amount=#{row.grossAmount},fee_amount=#{row.feeAmount}, net_amount=#{row.netAmount},net_amount_overridden_yn=#{row.netAmountOverriddenYn},settlement_status=#{row.settlementStatus},memo=#{row.memo}, farmer_confirm_status=#{row.farmerConfirmStatus},farmer_confirmed_by=#{row.farmerConfirmedBy},farmer_confirmed_at=#{row.farmerConfirmedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},version=version+1 WHERE farm_id=#{row.farmId} AND id=#{row.id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE work_logpest_control_log harvest_logsales_log SET deleted_at=#{now},updated_by=#{userId},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE work_logpest_control_logharvest_logsales_log SET farmer_confirm_status=#{status},farmer_confirmed_by=#{userId},farmer_confirmed_at=#{now}, updated_by=#{userId},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND created_role='FARM_CARE_MANAGER' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,CASE WHEN active_yn='Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END active_yn FROM farm_zone WHERE id=#{id} AND farm_id=#{farmId} AND active_yn='Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM farm_zone_assignment a WHERE a.zone_id=farm_zone.id AND a.farm_id=#{farmId} AND a.effective_to IS NULL AND a.active_yn='Y')

SELECT z.id,z.name,z.active_yn FROM farm_zone z JOIN farm_zone_assignment a ON a.zone_id=z.id AND a.farm_id=#{farmId} AND a.effective_to IS NULL AND a.active_yn='Y' WHERE z.id=#{id} AND z.farm_id=#{farmId} AND z.active_yn='Y' AND z.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.id,c.name,fc.active_yn FROM farm_crop fc JOIN crop c ON c.id=fc.crop_id WHERE fc.farm_id=#{farmId} AND c.id=#{id} AND fc.active_yn='Y'
SELECT v.id,v.name,fv.active_yn FROM farm_crop_variety fv JOIN crop_variety v ON v.id=fv.variety_id WHERE fv.farm_id=#{farmId} AND fv.crop_id=#{cropId} AND v.id=#{id} AND fv.active_yn='Y'
SELECT id,name,CASE WHEN status='ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END active_yn FROM crop_season WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id,name,active_yn FROM work_type WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND id=#{id} AND active_yn='Y'
SELECT id,name,CASE WHEN active_yn='Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END active_yn FROM customer WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND id=#{id} AND active_yn='Y' AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id,display_name name,'Y' active_yn FROM users WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT 'WORK' record_type,l.id,l.farm_id,l.zone_id,l.work_date record_date,wt.name primary_label, CONCAT(COALESCE(l.worker_count,''),'명 ',COALESCE(l.work_hours,''),'시간') primary_value,l.created_by,l.created_role,l.care_assignment_id,l.farmer_confirm_status,l.created_at FROM work_log l LEFT JOIN work_type wt ON wt.id=l.work_type_id WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'PEST_CONTROL',l.id,l.farm_id,l.zone_id,l.apply_date,l.chemical_name,l.target_pest,l.created_by,l.created_role,l.care_assignment_id,l.farmer_confirm_status,l.created_at FROM pest_control_log l WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'HARVEST',l.id,l.farm_id,l.zone_id,l.harvest_date,'수확',CONCAT(l.quantity,' ',l.unit),l.created_by,l.created_role,l.care_assignment_id,l.farmer_confirm_status,l.created_at FROM harvest_log l WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'SALES',l.id,l.farm_id,NULL,l.sales_date,COALESCE(l.item_name,c.name,'품목 미입력'),CONCAT(l.net_amount,'원'),l.created_by,l.created_role,l.care_assignment_id,l.farmer_confirm_status,l.created_at FROM sales_log l LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id=l.customer_id WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT u.id,u.display_name name,'Y' active_yn FROM users u JOIN ( SELECT created_by FROM work_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION SELECT created_by FROM pest_control_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION SELECT created_by FROM harvest_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION SELECT created_by FROM sales_log WHERE farm_id=#{farmId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ) a ON a.created_by=u.id ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id
